title: Kitaev Non-Adaptive X/Y Hadamard Test vs. Coherent Adaptive R_Z(-phi_known) Feedforward
claims: Even with optimal Bayesian post-rotation using phi_known, 2 copies (1 X + 1 Y) of Kitaev's non-adaptive quadrature measurement have Bayes error 0.5*(1 - gamma*max(|cos(phi)|, |sin(phi)|)) >= 0.5*(1 - gamma) (worse than 1 copy of coherent R_Z(-phi_known) feedforward!).
Coherent R_Z(-phi_known) feedforward achieves an exact 2.0x per-copy Fisher information gain over non-adaptive X/Y sampling across all phi_known.
favorable_controls: Angle sweep phi in {0, pi/8, pi/4, 3*pi/8, pi/2} at gamma = 0.8
